episodes.title: La trampa
episodes.summary: Helena is the perfect wife — until her passionate affair with a younger man spirals into a dangerous scheme to obtain her freedom.

episodes.title: Reencuentro
episodes.summary: An argument escalates into a bloody scene. Iván's cover is blown as his trust in Helena wavers. Octavio tries to keep the police investigation hidden.

episodes.title: Desesperada
episodes.summary: Octavio is kidnapped by El Magic, who just wants Claudio. As Iván questions Helena's motives, Fer spirals. Octavio makes a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Bajo sospecha
episodes.summary: Octavio and Helena clash as Iván learns more about Claudio's secretive parties. Livia reunites with an old flame, and Fer makes a terrible confession.

episodes.title: Las dudas
episodes.summary: Octavio fights the clock as he executes El Magic's plan to find Claudio. Iván spins a tale for Pablo, and Livia makes a new online dating match.

episodes.title: Falsa muerte
episodes.summary: Iván learns about Helena's dark side. Octavio and El Magic conspire to fool everyone. Claudio faces his captor.

episodes.title: La caída del fiscal
episodes.summary: A phone call gives Livia hope, and Iván's responsibilities catch up to him. When Pablo's secret comes out, he's forced to the edge of reason.

episodes.title: La llamada
episodes.summary: Claudio attempts an escape while Livia's suspicions about Octavio are fueled. As Helena recovers in the hospital, another video leaks.

episodes.title: Capturados
episodes.summary: Livia and Iván are kidnapped. Sofía turns her eye to Antonio. Rafael worries about a third video leak, and a derelict chapel yields a startling sight.

episodes.title: Está vivo
episodes.summary: Claudio's return threatens to break the Martínezes. Another video leak threatens a high-powered executive. Helena plots a new escape.

episodes.title: Chantaje
episodes.summary: Fedra and Antonio adjust their plans as Montero files a claim against Claudio and Helena. Livia meets Rebeca, and El Magic pays Claudio a visit.

episodes.title: Secreto del pasado
episodes.summary: Claudio exacts revenge on his enemies, starting with Helena. Fedra gets close to Octavio. Iván's secret comes out, as Rafael reaches out to Helena.

episodes.title: Escándalo
episodes.summary: Claudio settles a score, and an online leak tears Helena and Iván apart. As Helena and Fer seek refuge in an unlikely place, Livia gets what she wants.

episodes.title: Desilusión
episodes.summary: Sofía's suspicions raise questions for Livia. Iván and Rebeca get a scare. Rafael and Dora are tested, as Claudio and Fedra have a dicey confrontation.

episodes.title: Todos contra todos
episodes.summary: A police investigation into Claudio's death leads to several suspects. Octavio discovers Fedra's deceit as Livia overhears Iván's shocking confession.

episodes.title: Revelaciones
episodes.summary: Helena is arrested while Iván and Livia find clues to Fedra's past. El Licenciado plans a hit on Octavio. Fer unlocks a key piece to his past.

episodes.title: Duro golpe
episodes.summary: Rafael gives Fer the truth, and Helena conceals it. Iván overhears Sofía and Benítez. Arcadia's revenge claims a life. El Licenciado comes calling.

episodes.title: Nueva vida
episodes.summary: As Livia and Octavio face El Licenciado, Helena has one more scheme up her sleeve. Sofía closes a case — but will another one open?
